scope: Mod原创城镇信任层；与原作声誉、本Mod阵营承诺分层。设计语义，未映射引擎；不改游戏包。

source_layers.note_cn: 聚落与阵营两级、档位、来源明细、历史与跨地传播均归原作；本设计不改写、不冒充其档位消息，也不把同一行为重复计两份。原版经验见[[原作剧情与对话系统参照]]。
source_layers.note_en: Village and faction scopes, tiers, source ledger, history and spread belong to the base game; this design never rewrites them or double-counts the same deed.

source_layers.note_cn: 沿用现有F01..F08的local_trust −2..+2，只在具体支线条款实际执行后写入；托管资格等按原字段判定。
source_layers.note_en: Existing F01..F08 local_trust stays as-is; written only after concrete clauses actually execute.

source_layers.note_cn: 本页新增层：十五个地域各一条记录，五档；只从实际执行、最小核验的成果写入；用于对话语气、有限服务与回访伏笔，不替代结局资格。
source_layers.note_en: This layer: one record per region, five bands, written only from executed and minimally verified outcomes; drives voice, limited services and callbacks — never ending eligibility.

scale.behavior_cn: 只保原基本服务与双向回程；本地新增服务关闭；NPC只谈当下事务，不给邀请与转介；不缉拿、不代原版犯罪处理。
scale.behavior_en: Base services and return route only; mod services closed; no invitations or referrals; never applies base-game crime handling.

scale.behavior_cn: 本地新增服务限范围或限时开放；报价不改，但先问已核事实；需要本人分项授权的事逐项再问。
scale.behavior_en: Mod services open only in restricted scope or hours; prices unchanged; verified facts asked first; consent items re-asked one by one.

scale.behavior_cn: 基础服务按原价；可听公开需要；不授予本地署名、邀请与优先位置。
scale.behavior_en: Base services at normal price; public needs audible; no local credit, invitations or priority.

scale.behavior_cn: 回执语气按已核事实回应；一处小便利（预约位/优先时段/小额折扣，单渠道不超15%）；可收到本地待办提示。
scale.behavior_en: Receipts answered by verified fact; one small convenience (slot/priority/wording discount up to 15% in one channel); local pending work hinted.

scale.behavior_cn: 获得本地具名位置与一次性回访伏笔；仍不越本人授权、不无限供物、不代签。
scale.behavior_en: A named local place and one-time callbacks; still no override of consent, no unlimited stock, no proxy signatures.

rules.cn: 只写实际执行且经最小核验的成果；预览、询问、拒绝、缺场、单纯完成对话都不写。
rules.en: Only executed and minimally verified outcomes write; previews, questions, refusals, absences and dialogue alone never do.

rules.cn: 每来源一次：主线章按实际路线±1，支线按实际交付±1，日常不改档；重大明确伤害−1；上限±2。
rules.en: Once per source: regional chapters and side chains ±1 by real delivery; dailies never change bands; explicit grave harm −1; cap ±2.

rules.cn: 与原作声誉分开：不改写其档位消息与来源，也不把同一行为重复计为两份声望。
rules.en: Separate from base-game reputation: never rewrite its tier messages or sources, never double-count one deed.

rules.cn: 罪行、赃物与刑罚仍由原作处理；城镇信任不能洗罪名、抵罚金或换销赃。
rules.en: Crime, stolen goods and punishment remain base-game; town trust never washes charges, fines or fences goods.

rules.cn: 低信任不锁主线、基本服务与双向回程；负档不逼卖人，也不生成寻仇刷怪。
rules.en: Low trust never locks the main line, base services or return routes; negative bands never force selling people or spawn revenge mobs.

rules.cn: 服务折扣单渠道≤15%，不叠成负价；高信任不无限抽物资、劳工、床位或仓位。
rules.en: Service discounts ≤15% in one channel, never stacking below cost; high trust never yields unlimited stock, labour, beds or berths.

rules.cn: 无静默衰减；补救与实际赔付另记，伤害史不删；只重评未来，不倒改历史。
rules.en: No silent decay; remedies and real compensation are logged separately; history never rewrites, only future reevaluates.

rules.cn: 最终确认之后冻结：之后只做回访与未来维护，不重选旧方法、不改旧快照。
rules.en: Frozen after the final confirmation: only callbacks and future upkeep; old methods and snapshots never change.

rules.cn: 死亡、缺席、拒绝优先：死者不发言、不补授权；缺场只留记录，不拿柜员代答。
rules.en: Death, absence and refusal come first: the dead never speak or grant; records stand in, never a clerk's impersonation.

rules.cn: 跨城只走明列传递与听闻；同一成果不得在多城重复计成同等数字。
rules.en: Cross-town flow uses only listed transfers and hearsay entries; one deed never counts as full value in several towns.

ui.legend_cn: 只记实际做过的事；拒绝与中立不写负数；查明伤害另记；原作声誉另页。
ui.legend_en: Only verifiable deeds are recorded; refusal is not a negative; proven harm is separate; base-game reputation stays on its own page.
ui.gate_cn: 这扇门现在只开到{band}允许的范围。
ui.gate_en: This door opens only as far as {band} allows.
ui.freeze_cn: 残光之井确认之后，城镇记录不再回写旧选择。
ui.freeze_en: After the Well confirmation, town records never rewrite past choices.

transfers.cn: 粮路账目实际进港并核验后，布林按城联旧例收下‘部分’份额；重复运粮不再叠加。
transfers.en: Once the grain ledger actually reaches the harbour and is verified, Brynn records its union 'portion'; repeated hauling never stacks.

transfers.cn: 酒账经港口报关核验后记一次；家酿小单不触发。
transfers.en: One entry after the cellar ledger clears the harbour; small private orders do not trigger it.

transfers.cn: 堤料账并入城联记录后记一次；不含未付预付款。
transfers.en: One entry once the dike-material account joins the union record; unpaid advances excluded.

transfers.cn: 王廷采买旧例：家纹布实际进入衬里线核验后，奥尔德文记一次‘部分’。
transfers.en: Court custom: after marked cloth actually enters the lining line, Aldwynn records its 'portion' once.

transfers.cn: 灰军旧例：经核验的旧梁实际进入矿架后记一次；不证明现时木材永远充足。
transfers.en: Legion custom: one entry after verified old timber reaches the pit frames; no proof of endless supplies.

transfers.cn: 护理抄本线实际接通后记一次；药物与工时仍按实际到班另核。
transfers.en: One entry once the care-copy line actually connects; drugs and shifts still verified on delivery.

bands.line_cn: 「不用报了。你这名字在另一本簿子上。」
bands.line_en: "Don't bother calling. Your name sits in the other ledger."

bands.line_cn: 「东西可以买。话先说到能查的那一段。」
bands.line_en: "You can buy. Talk only goes as far as it can be checked."

bands.line_cn: 「布林不留人，只留账。」
bands.line_en: "Brynn keeps ledgers, not guests."

bands.line_cn: 「那一笔我看见了。下次报名字短一点就行。」
bands.line_en: "I saw that entry. Next time, your name can be shorter."

bands.line_cn: 「进来吧。灯位给你留着，账还是照记。」
bands.line_en: "Come in. A lamp seat is kept for you — the ledger still rules."

writes.cn: 本地主章任一实际路线执行并交接后记一次。
writes.en: Once after any executed regional-chapter route actually hands over.

writes.cn: 实际更正与留档执行后。
writes.en: After the real amendment and record are executed.

writes.cn: 水门实际分流并在两栏登记后。
writes.en: After the water gate actually splits flow and both columns are logged.

writes.cn: 工人生死与去向按本人范围实际落定、回执按IN-BRY实际送达后记一次；worker_status=dead不写。
writes.en: Once worker status lands within personal scope and the IN-BRY receipt is actually passed; not with worker_status=dead.

writes.cn: 撤保、停追与赔付实际执行后按既有条款记一次；buyout只救人，不写制度承诺。
writes.en: Once after guarantees are actually withdrawn and compensation executed; buyout saves people but writes no institutional promise.

writes.cn: 转嫁伤害已执行且未remedied时写−1；补救完成后不再回改，这条负档只说明历史。
writes.en: −1 while shifted harm stands unremedied; after remedy it still stands as history, never rewritten.

receipt.cn: IN-BRY回执只含本案已公开的核验范围；不展未授权名单与住址。
receipt.en: The IN-BRY receipt carries only this case's already-public verification scope.

unlock.cn: 受托可在〈四区小听席〉旁听一次；不代投票、不保证议题、不换账页。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one listening seat at the Four-Ward Bench; no vote, no agenda promise, no ledger pages.

echo.cn: 听闻（奥斯布鲁克粮路经核验）：可以问「那车到了没有」，但不自动知道全部粮账。
echo.en: Hearsay (verified Osbrook grain): you may ask about that cart, never the whole ledger.

limits.cn: 四城区原街、原商店与原任务不因信任改开门；犯罪照原作；高信任不给无限仓位与免费修补。
limits.en: Original streets, shops and quests never re-gate by trust; crime stays base-game; high trust grants no free berths or repairs.

bands.line_cn: 「堤上不留对面的人。水退不退，都一样的。」
bands.line_en: "The dike keeps no room for the other side. Water or no water."

bands.line_cn: 「潮线上来之前，你把话说完。」
bands.line_en: "Finish before the tide line."

bands.line_cn: 「都在等。你要是也等，就往边上站站。」
bands.line_en: "Everyone's waiting. If you're waiting too, stand aside."

bands.line_cn: 「那一段有你抬过的石头。别自己再把它抬走。」
bands.line_en: "You carried stones for that stretch. Don't carry them off again."

bands.line_cn: 「名字上堤了。潮来的时候我们照念，不照拜。」
bands.line_en: "Your name is on the dike. We read it at high water — we don't worship it."

writes.cn: 堤段与租约实际落定后记一次。
writes.en: Once after dike sections and leases actually settle.

writes.cn: 第四人身份按本人授权实际处理后才写；b路保0，不扣。
writes.en: Only after the fourth person's case is handled on personal consent; route b stays 0, no penalty.

writes.cn: IN-DEN回执实际送达且本地接收棚按本人范围确认后记一次。
writes.en: Once the IN-DEN receipt is actually delivered and shelters confirm within personal scope.

receipt.cn: 无钟之夜的结果只以本地已公开范围进入丹布里；不替失踪者签名，不预支安置。
receipt.en: The bell-night outcome enters Denbrie only as its public scope; no proxy signatures, no advance housing.

unlock.cn: 受托可在棚簿留一行经手记录（只读一圈，不改租契、不动床位）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one handling line in the shelters' book — one read-around, no lease or bed changes.

echo.cn: 听闻（布林港账问过堤料）：可以回答「布林的账房问过」，不自动知道价格与工期。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may say Brynn's clerks asked about dike materials — never the price or schedule.

limits.cn: 洪灾旧损与租住条件照原；负档不赶人出屋、不收回已付租；水位与保存仍按原作。
limits.en: Flood damage and tenancy stay base-game; negative bands neither evict nor reclaim settled rent.

bands.line_cn: 「篱门不是给你扶的。往路边站。」
bands.line_en: "The gate isn't yours to hold. Stand off."

bands.line_cn: 「用哪件先说，别顺手。」
bands.line_en: "Name it before you take it."

bands.line_cn: 「今年说今年的话。来年的事来年问。」
bands.line_en: "This year's talk for this year. Ask next year for next."

bands.line_cn: 「你留的那袋没动。要不要看看袋口？」
bands.line_en: "Your sack's untouched. Want to see the knot?"

bands.line_cn: 「三道篱都认得你。别把篱当门踹。」
bands.line_en: "All three hedges know you. Don't kick them like doors."

writes.cn: 留种或预支实际交付后记一次。
writes.en: Once after the kept seed or advance is actually delivered.

writes.cn: 三篱门实际共用安排执行后；b保持0。
writes.en: After the shared-gate arrangement executes; b stays 0.

receipt.cn: 日常回执只改本地服务的物料与时段，不改档。
receipt.en: Daily receipts change local service materials and hours only, never bands.

unlock.cn: 受托可先看麦根庄未分柜的实到量（只读、不外带、不截留）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: first look at Maigen's unallocated deliveries — read-only, nothing carried off.

echo.cn: 听闻（曼郡酒账）：可问「今年桶够不够」，不改变任何配给。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask whether barrels suffice this year; allocations stay untouched.

limits.cn: 粮、地契与领主关系照原；信任不改收成、不给预留田；负档不烧青苗、不锁磨坊。
limits.en: Grain, deeds and lordship stay base-game; trust changes no harvest and reserves no field; negative bands never burn crops or lock the mill.

bands.line_cn: 「第一杯是生意。第二杯先别提。」
bands.line_en: "The first pour is trade. Don't ask for the second."

bands.line_cn: 「桶底的字你还认得吧？」
bands.line_en: "You still know the letters on the barrel's base?"

bands.line_cn: 「先尝尝。别急着说年份。」
bands.line_en: "Taste first. Don't call the year yet."

bands.line_cn: 「你经手那批的颜色，我们记得。」
bands.line_en: "We recall the colour of the batch you handled."

bands.line_cn: 「那格空着，牌上写着你的记号。」
bands.line_en: "That rack stays empty — the tag carries your mark."

writes.cn: 新标或限量方案实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once after the new label or limited scheme actually executes.

writes.cn: 种枝实际交接与收益分开后。
writes.en: After cuttings actually hand over with proceeds separated.

writes.cn: 两处独立保管/校核实际成立后记一次；exclusive不写、不扣。
writes.en: Once two independent custodies/checks actually hold; exclusive writes nothing and loses nothing.

receipt.cn: 抄本回执只谈技术差异与保管，不宣布全库已见。
receipt.en: Copy receipts speak to technical gaps and custody only; never to having seen the whole archive.

unlock.cn: 受托可得一格空酒位存玩家自己的桶（不可售、不代管配方）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one empty rack for your own cask — not for sale, no recipe custody.

echo.cn: 听闻（布林报关）：可以问「港上这批要不要换标」，不自动知道配额。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask whether the harbour batch needs a new label; quotas stay unknown.

limits.cn: 酒业产值与商会关系照原；信任不改税、不给独家配方；负档不砸桶、不锁酒窖。
limits.en: Wine economy and guild ties stay base-game; no tax or recipe changes; negative bands never smash barrels or lock cellars.

bands.line_cn: 「尺不为你开。站远一点，别碰架。」
bands.line_en: "The measure stays closed. Step back from the rack."

bands.line_cn: 「看可以。合不合身，今天不提。」
bands.line_en: "Looking is fine. Fitting is not for today."

bands.line_cn: 「门开着，案子上的名字不是你的。」
bands.line_en: "The door is open; the name on the bench isn't yours."

bands.line_cn: 「你那道痕还在尺上。别急着刮平。」
bands.line_en: "Your mark is still on the measure. Don't smooth it yet."

bands.line_cn: 「衬里上的字按你同意的缝。要拆，也得你来说。」
bands.line_en: "The lining letters are stitched as you agreed. Unpicking is yours to ask."

writes.cn: 公开、分散或封存方案实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once after the open, distributed or sealed scheme actually executes.

writes.cn: 旧墙实际按新用途保下后。
writes.en: After the old wall is actually kept for its new use.

writes.cn: IN-ALD回执实际送达且监督条款落地后记一次；不代发原奖励。
writes.en: Once the IN-ALD receipt passes and supervision clauses land; no re-issuing original rewards.

receipt.cn: 军需回执只含已公开监督范围；不重发军需奖励。
receipt.en: The quartermaster receipt holds only public supervision scope; no re-issued rewards.

unlock.cn: 受托可申请一件私人工具的挂墙位（工具仍限借出、照费）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: wall space for one personal tool — loans and fees unchanged.

echo.cn: 听闻（约斯特文布批）：可问「衬里的布到了没有」，不保证优先取料。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask whether the lining cloth arrived; no priority claim.

limits.cn: 军需与宗教史照原；信任不改原商店、不替王室授权；负档不砸炉、不拒基础修理。
limits.en: Armory and religious history stay base-game; no royal authority; negative bands never smash forges or block base repairs.

bands.line_cn: 「炉子不认识你。要等，就在门外等。」
bands.line_en: "The forge doesn't know you. Wait outside."

bands.line_cn: 「不是不卖，是先卖认识的人。」
bands.line_en: "Not refusing — just serving the known first."

bands.line_cn: 「站远点，火星不认新衣服。」
bands.line_en: "Stand back; sparks don't respect new clothes."

bands.line_cn: 「你添的那把炭，火记得。」
bands.line_en: "The fire remembers the coal you fed it."

bands.line_cn: 「炉边那块地方留着。别拿它当招牌。」
bands.line_en: "A spot by the forge is kept. Don't use it as a signboard."

writes.cn: 赎金实付到人或合法处置实际执行后记一次；家属未获真结果不写。
writes.en: Once ransom truly reaches the family or a lawful disposal executes; no write without a real family outcome.

writes.cn: 预付款实际结清到人后。
writes.en: After the advance actually settles to the worker.

writes.cn: 补偿或配给实际到受害方且库可查后记一次；military不写、不扣。
writes.en: Once compensation or rationing really reaches victims with a checkable store; military writes nothing.

receipt.cn: 被征用冬粮回执按已公开范围到本地；不把未补损失说成已补。
receipt.en: The requisition receipt lands with its public scope; unpaid losses never read as paid.

unlock.cn: 受托可预约一次炉位（不插队、不免料、不押工)。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one reserved forge slot — no queue jumps, no free stock, no bonded labour.

echo.cn: 听闻（奥尔德文采买）：可问「甲片什么时候过炉」，不换工期。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask when the plate takes the fire; schedules stay fixed.

limits.cn: 冶炼、征募与王廷辖属照原；信任不折赎金为积分、不许无限代工；负档不熄公用炉。
limits.en: Smelting, levy and court rule stay base-game; no ransom-as-points, no endless commission; negative bands never douse the public forge.

bands.line_cn: 「想看反面？这块布还轮不到你。」
bands.line_en: "The reverse side? Not for you yet."

bands.line_cn: 「花边先收着。素的够你过冬。」
bands.line_en: "The figured trim stays boxed. Plain cloth will warm you."

bands.line_cn: 「织机排着。你的名字在队尾。」
bands.line_en: "The loom is queued; your name sits at the tail."

bands.line_cn: 「去年那件没冻着人。行里的账记得。」
bands.line_en: "Last winter's piece didn't freeze anyone. The row remembers."

bands.line_cn: 「素面留了一匹。价钱照旧，绣样另谈。」
bands.line_en: "A plain bolt is kept. Same price; figure work is separate."

writes.cn: 共用家纹或独立方案实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once after the shared-mark or independent scheme actually executes.

writes.cn: 徒弟离坊或续约按本人意愿实际落定后。
writes.en: After the apprentice's leave or renewal actually lands on their own will.

writes.cn: 水堰颜色与排放实际处理后才写。
writes.en: Only after the weir's colour and discharge are actually handled.

receipt.cn: IN-YOS只收已公开的回程核验；不宣布全山安全、不预支国家资格。
receipt.en: IN-YOS takes only the public return verification; no mountain-wide safety claim, no state clearance.

unlock.cn: 受托留一匹素面布的优先购买权（实价、限一匹、可拒卖）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: priority claim on one plain bolt — real price, one bolt, seller may still decline.

echo.cn: 听闻（奥尔德文衬里线）：可问「哪一色先织」，不替匠人排期。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask which colour weaves first; artisans keep their schedule.

limits.cn: 羊毛与旧亚麻印象分开；信任不无限供货、不炫配方；负档不剪断织机、不追回已售布。
limits.en: Wool is kept distinct from old linen impressions; no endless supply or recipe exposure; negative bands never cut looms or reclaim sold cloth.

bands.line_cn: 「这门里没有你的名字。问了也一样。」
bands.line_en: "No name of yours in this door. Asking changes nothing."

bands.line_cn: 「凭据先放桌上，再谈别的。」
bands.line_en: "Papers on the desk first."

bands.line_cn: 「柜子有格子。人没有。」
bands.line_en: "The cabinet has slots. People don't."

bands.line_cn: 「那一件对上了。就那一件。」
bands.line_en: "That one matched. Just that one."

bands.line_cn: 「留灯驿那盏，写着给你留的。宿资照收。」
bands.line_en: "The lamp at Liudeng is kept for you. Lodging still costs."

writes.cn: 限权或保管方案实际执行后记一次；族史unknown不填。
writes.en: Once the limited or custody scheme executes; unknown family history stays unfilled.

writes.cn: 成年的当事者实际获得合法安排后。
writes.en: After the adult party actually receives a lawful arrangement.

writes.cn: IN-KOR按本人许可实际送达且本地只读该范围后记一次。
writes.en: Once the IN-KOR receipt passes within personal consent and the town reads only that scope.

receipt.cn: 家书回执只到投递与本人许可范围；不公开未准地址。
receipt.en: Letter receipts carry delivery and consent scope only; unapproved addresses stay closed.

unlock.cn: 受托可在留灯驿留一盏夜灯一次（不赊宿资、不换取凭据）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one night lamp at Liudeng — no credit, no papers traded.

echo.cn: 听闻（柏石关点名）：可问「那边点到什么名字」，不合并两本册。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask which names the Pass called; the two ledgers never merge.

limits.cn: 身份、寄存与族史照原未知范围；信任不判归属、不换真凭；负档不夺旧寄存物。
limits.en: Identity, deposits and family history stay within original unknowns; trust never assigns kinship or trades papers.

bands.line_cn: 「林子今天不请你。旧道也别走。」
bands.line_en: "The woods don't invite you today. Not even the old path."

bands.line_cn: 「走旧道，别抄近的。」
bands.line_en: "Old paths. No shortcuts."

bands.line_cn: 「路可以指。林子的事少问。」
bands.line_en: "Directions, yes. Fewer questions about the woods."

bands.line_cn: 「你留的那株长着。别到处说。」
bands.line_en: "The tree you spared is growing. Don't brag."

bands.line_cn: 「你的哨声岗上认得。夜路别吹错调。」
bands.line_en: "The post knows your whistle. Don't blow the wrong tune at night."

writes.cn: 旧料或本地优先方案实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once after the old-stock or local-first scheme executes.

writes.cn: 护林岗哨与巡段安排实际落定后。
writes.en: After the forest post and patrol arrangements actually settle.

writes.cn: 拒押送、实际试车与承运条款落地后记一次；sponsor保留运输伤害，不写。
writes.en: Once refusal-of-press, a real trial run and a carriage clause land; sponsor keeps its transport harm and writes nothing.

receipt.cn: 桥路回执只到实际承运与拒押范围；不预支通行垄断。
receipt.en: Bridge receipts carry actual carriage and refusal scope only; no passage monopoly.

unlock.cn: 受托可申请一次同行走旧道的引导（不代巡、不代罚）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one escorted walk on the old path — no patrol duty, no punishment proxy.

echo.cn: 听闻（佛尔霍特矿架）：可问「旧梁够不够架一段」，不转金账。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask whether old beams suffice for one frame; gold accounts stay put.

limits.cn: 林地管辖与民兵照原；信任不改木材出口量、不给猎场特权；负档不退已运木材、不封村。
limits.en: Forest authority and militia stay base-game; no export or hunting privilege; negative bands never reclaim delivered timber.

bands.line_cn: 「你的灯下不了井。上头照照就回吧。」
bands.line_en: "Your lamp doesn't go below. Shine above and leave."

bands.line_cn: 「走下去每一步，工头都记着。」
bands.line_en: "Every step down is marked by the foreman."

bands.line_cn: 「矿上认砂，不认脸。」
bands.line_en: "The pit knows its sand, not faces."

bands.line_cn: 「你淘的那罐过了秤。井上也有你一句话。」
bands.line_en: "Your vial weighed true. Your word counts above now."

bands.line_cn: 「停班的时候，簿上会有人替你答一声。」
bands.line_en: "At the stop, someone answers for you in the book."

writes.cn: 停班或外部方案实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once after the stop-work or external scheme executes.

writes.cn: 矿份按实际持有人分配后。
writes.en: After mine-shares land with their actual holders.

writes.cn: 洗砂村水色与砂账实际分开处理后。
writes.en: After the washing village separates water tone from sand accounts.

receipt.cn: IN-FOR只读已公开的回程核验；不宣布矿脉安全、不授采矿权。
receipt.en: IN-FOR reads only the public return verification; no seam safety claim, no mining rights.

unlock.cn: 受托可看停班簿上已核工时（只读一次，不改排班与欠款）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one read of verified hours in the stop book — no roster or debt changes.

echo.cn: 听闻（伊德斯旧梁）：可问「梁到哪一批」，不换矿份。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask which beam batch arrived; shares stay untouched.

limits.cn: 金矿、旧骑卫与北疆石场分开；信任不减安全规程、不许无票下井；负档不填井、不夺已发工钱。
limits.en: Gold mine, old riders and northern quarries stay distinct; no safety rollback or unticketed descent; negative bands never seal pits or claw back wages.

bands.line_cn: 「铃不响给外面的人听。」
bands.line_en: "The bell doesn't ring for outsiders."

bands.line_cn: 「讲可以。先对一对年份。」
bands.line_en: "Tell it, but match the year first."

bands.line_cn: 「兽死了，故事还活着。你听哪一版？」
bands.line_en: "The beast is dead; the story lives. Which version?"

bands.line_cn: 「你补的那行，和旧碑并排挂着。」
bands.line_en: "Your line hangs beside the old stele."

bands.line_cn: 「静铃那一刻，会有人想到你的名字。就一次。」
bands.line_en: "At the still bell, someone thinks of your name. Once."

writes.cn: 补录或家属方案实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once the addendum or family scheme actually executes.

writes.cn: 静铃仪式与纪念物用途实际厘清后。
writes.en: After the still-bell rite and memorial uses are actually settled.

receipt.cn: 墓标回执只含已登记身份范围；不公开未准墓位。
receipt.en: Marker receipts hold registered identity scope only; unapproved plots stay closed.

unlock.cn: 受托可在静铃一刻留一次默记（不发纪念章、不改碑文）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one silent remembrance at the bell — no medal, no stele edits.

echo.cn: 听闻（佛尔霍特停班）：可问「他们真的停过吗」，不替死者下结论。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask whether the stop really happened; conclusions about the dead stay open.

limits.cn: 旧狂兽已死，不再复活卖第二遍；信任不改纪念物归属、不伪英雄故事；负档不挖旧碑。
limits.en: The old beast stays dead; no second hero tale; memorial ownership and truth stay fixed.

bands.line_cn: 「名字上画了道。今天不用排了。」
bands.line_en: "Your name is struck. No queue for you today."

bands.line_cn: 「每次都要看印。别嫌慢。」
bands.line_en: "The seal is checked every time. Don't complain."

bands.line_cn: 「关里的规矩，先说一遍再进。」
bands.line_en: "The pass rules get said once before you enter."

bands.line_cn: 「上一次点名，你对上了。」
bands.line_en: "Last roll call, your line matched."

bands.line_cn: 「夜里过，不叫你。印还是要看一次。」
bands.line_en: "At night you pass uncalled — the seal still gets one look."

writes.cn: 联合或中立核验方案实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once the joint or neutral verification scheme executes.

writes.cn: 两份点名实际对上同一名单后。
writes.en: After the two roll calls actually match one list.

writes.cn: IN-PAS回执按已公开监督范围送达后记一次。
writes.en: Once the IN-PAS receipt passes within public supervision scope.

writes.cn: 交出藏身人写exchange_harm时记−1；trace/pay不清除。
writes.en: −1 when a hiding person is surrendered (exchange_harm); trace/pay never erase it.

receipt.cn: 军需回执只读已公开范围；二奖不因本地信任补发。
receipt.en: Quartermaster receipts read public scope only; trust never re-issues rewards.

unlock.cn: 受托可在副榜旁看一次实到点名（只读、不代点、不补章）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one read of the actual roll beside the deputy list — no proxy call, no seal substitutions.

echo.cn: 听闻（考德寄存）：可问「那边有没有我的凭据」，不跨册合并。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask whether Kord holds your papers; ledgers never merge.

limits.cn: 秩序经得起查问：信任不替代印章与点名，低信任也保双向与其他常规通行；负档不押人、不扣合法货。
limits.en: Order survives scrutiny: trust never replaces seals or roll calls, and low trust keeps passage; negative bands never jail or seize lawful goods.

bands.line_cn: 「登记簿上有过你的位置。后来谁都没来。」
bands.line_en: "Your slot was logged once. Nobody came for it."

bands.line_cn: 「水给你。别的先别问。」
bands.line_en: "Water, yes. Ask nothing else today."

bands.line_cn: 「先看你今天能接哪一班。」
bands.line_en: "First: which shift can you actually take today?"

bands.line_cn: 「你到的那班有记录。人也真歇过。」
bands.line_en: "The shift you took is logged. Someone truly rested."

bands.line_cn: 「碗照空着，名字留了。下一班再问本人。」
bands.line_en: "The bowl stays empty; the name stays kept. The next shift asks them first."

writes.cn: 留营或分散接收按本人范围实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once local or distributed care executes within personal scope.

writes.cn: 替护真到班且患者与陪护各自同意后。
writes.en: After relief shifts truly arrive with patient and carer consent each.

writes.cn: 观察捆绑实际撤销、普通分配真到人后；b保持0。
writes.en: After observation is truly unbundled and ordinary shares delivered; b stays 0.

writes.cn: IN-ASH回执按已公开范围送达且本地水/护理按本人核验后记一次。
writes.en: Once the IN-ASH receipt lands within public scope and local water/care passes personal checks.

receipt.cn: 热病回执只到已核的水与班次；不说全营痊愈、不代签研究。
receipt.en: Fever receipts cover verified water and shifts only; no camp-wide cure, no research proxy.

unlock.cn: 受托可列席一次班次分配（只读、不代签、不占床位）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one seat at shift allotment — listen only, no proxy, no bed taken.

echo.cn: 听闻（曼恩护理抄本）：可问「那页剂量到没到」，药与工时仍另核。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask whether that dosage page arrived; drugs and hours still verified separately.

limits.cn: 护理不是研究许可、普通照护不是救济资格；低信任保水与回程；负档不停基本水、不赶轻患者。
limits.en: Care is not research consent; ordinary aid is not relief eligibility; low trust keeps water and return; negative bands never cut basic water.

bands.line_cn: 「读数不是给你看的。站到栏外。」
bands.line_en: "The readings aren't for you. Behind the rail."

bands.line_cn: 「外道够你走。里头的回声别应。」
bands.line_en: "The outer path suffices. Don't answer the echoes."

bands.line_cn: 「想听就听。别拿听到的当证据。」
bands.line_en: "Listen if you will. What you hear isn't evidence."

bands.line_cn: 「你那次空载对上了一格。就一格。」
bands.line_en: "Your empty load matched a cell. Just one."

bands.line_cn: 「停牌旁边有你的记号，路还是按现在这段走。」
bands.line_en: "Your mark sits by the stop-board; the path still follows today's stretch."

writes.cn: 维护或最小方案实际执行后记一次。
writes.en: Once the maintenance or minimal scheme actually executes.

writes.cn: 限载验修与停牌范围实际核过后；b保持0，不扣。
writes.en: After limited-load repair and board scope are verified; b stays 0.

writes.cn: 复测或实交支架按实际条件完成且差异留unknown后记一次。
writes.en: Once re-tests or a delivered brace complete on real terms with differences left unknown.

writes.cn: N17冻结后的旧薪/交钥/必要职责按实际接收完成后记一次。
writes.en: Once wages, keys and required handovers complete after the N17 freeze.

receipt.cn: 回程核验只到已走的段与外道；不授NE5、不宣布井已稳。
receipt.en: Return verification covers walked sections and outer paths only; no NE5, no stable-well claim.

unlock.cn: 受托可先看下一班固定槽读数（只读、不代校、不带出）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: first read of the next fixed-gauge cycle — read-only, no calibration proxy.

echo.cn: 听闻（寒凉盆地护理）：可问「那一班人手够不够」，不改排班表。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask whether that shift is staffed; the roster stays fixed.

limits.cn: 校表不等于核心认证、支架不等于NE5；低信任保绕行与回程；负档不停外道、不清旧记录。
limits.en: Gauge work is not core certification, braces are not NE5; low trust keeps bypasses and return; negative bands never stop outer paths.

bands.line_cn: 「目录里没有你。书库更不会有。」
bands.line_en: "You're in no catalog. The stacks even less."

bands.line_cn: 「先给你目录。页数以后再说。」
bands.line_en: "The catalog first. Pages come later."

bands.line_cn: 「桌上有你的位置，架子上还没有。」
bands.line_en: "A desk place, not a shelf place."

bands.line_cn: 「你经手的那册登记过了。落款别改。」
bands.line_en: "The copy you handled is logged. Don't alter the colophon."

bands.line_cn: 「冷窗那盏给你留一夜。书不出馆。」
bands.line_en: "A lamp at the cold window for one night. Books stay inside."

writes.cn: 去留方案实际执行后记一次；焚毁与控制留史不改写。
writes.en: Once the stay-or-leave scheme executes; burning and control stay on record.

writes.cn: 凯姆的字按实际权责更正或留档后。
writes.en: After Kem's lines are corrected or archived on real authority.

writes.cn: IN-MAE回执送达且来源资格实际核过后记一次。
writes.en: Once the IN-MAE receipt passes with source credentials actually verified.

receipt.cn: 封存页回执只到来源与日期范围；不宣布全库已见。
receipt.en: Sealed-page receipts cover source and date scope only; never the whole archive.

unlock.cn: 受托可先看一册已登记抄本（不带出、不代署名）。
unlock.en: Entrusted: one logged copy to read on site — no removal, no proxy signature.

echo.cn: 听闻（拉滕旧狂兽）：可问「那篇记录谁写的」，作者责任照原。
echo.en: Hearsay: you may ask who wrote that record; authorship stays as-is.

limits.cn: 留下知识不等于留下压人的人；低信任保阅读基本入口与回程；负档不烧书、不逐合法住户。
limits.en: Keeping knowledge never keeps its oppressors; low trust keeps basic reading and return; negative bands never burn books or evict lawful residents.
